purpose: Establish the museum as prestigious, public, and safe-looking before the danger appears.
prompt: Wide establishing shot of a grand fantasy natural history museum in a cosmopolitan high-magic city, marble columns, broad steps, banners advertising a special Murkmire Stone exhibition, elegant visitors arriving in early evening light, a school field trip gathering near the entrance, bright adventurous tone with subtle mystery, painterly fantasy realism, no text or logos.
notes: Use at the start of the field trip.

purpose: Show the class as visitors, not burglars, before the heist premise starts.
prompt: A small group of fantasy magical-school students and a gnome teacher entering a natural history museum on a field trip, diverse young adventurers in neat travel clothes with subtle class hints, excited and curious expressions, museum banners, polished stone floors, families and donors in the background, warm optimistic lighting, painterly fantasy realism, no text.
notes: Do not try to exactly reproduce PC portraits unless using existing character references.

purpose: General museum interior and later after-hours navigation.

notes: The statues become animated armor after hours.

purpose: Main gala scene with social pressure and target visible.

prompt: Fantasy museum records room with filing cabinets, stacked exhibit ledgers, a desk covered in security diagrams and alarm spell invoices, faint blue magical annotations on a floor plan, dim lantern light, investigative mood, no readable text.

purpose: Campaign continuity image for the headmaster taking custody.
